title: Add [capabilities.study] to athena.toml and fix its unit test
summary: Retry of the rejected job: add only a [capabilities.study] section to athena.toml (no firstmate pinning), and update the study crate's test that asserted the section was absent, which failed `cargo test`. athena.toml must still parse and the full checks must pass.

defaults_applied.how: Only the study config section and the one test it invalidates.
The study crate test is updated so cargo test and clippy pass.
The test enforces that the section exists and drives grants and checks.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy, and fmt --check.
The failing test and the existing change section were read from the repository to infer the shape.

assumptions: The study section mirrors [capabilities.change]: producer_commands, verifier_commands, env, and checks (fmt, clippy, test), since studies are committed files and need the same gates.
The study capability is already registered in crates/athena-cli/src/wiring.rs; the missing piece is only the configuration section.
The prior failure was solely the study crate test asserting capability(ID).is_none(); it should now assert the section exists and that grants and checks come from it.
No firstmate pinning or other edits to athena.toml beyond the new section.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml gains a [capabilities.study] table (with its env table and checks as needed) and no other existing table changes.

The test in crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs no longer asserts the section is absent; it asserts capability("study") is present and that the producer/verifier commands and checks come from it, and the test name no longer says 'nothing_is_configured_yet'.
athena.toml is listed as a deliverable and named here as a governance file changed; no firstmate pinning is added.
Run `cargo test --locked`: all tests pass, including athena-cap-study tests and any test that parses athena.toml.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both clean.

out_of_scope: Changes to the change capability's configuration
Prompt or rules changes in the study crate
departures: Slightly higher pass probability: the failure cause is known and the change is small.
